records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Net sales for the first quarter of fiscal 2023 increased 9.1% to $3.30 billion from $3.02 billion for the first quarter of fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: The increase in net sales was driven by positive sales contributions from the acquisition of Orscheln Farm and Home, new store openings and growth in comparable store sales.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: We usually experience our highest inventory and accounts payable balances during our first fiscal quarter for purchases of seasonal products to support the higher sales volume of the spring selling season, and again during our third fiscal quarter to support the higher sales volume of the cold weather selling season.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: As a percent of net sales, gross margin in the first quarter of fiscal 2023 increased 52 basis points to 35.5% from 34.9% in the first quarter of fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Operating income for the first quarter of fiscal 2023 of $244.4 million was effectively flat compared to $244.3 million in the first quarter of fiscal 2022.
